shared_elements: low-relief carving on a vertically oriented stone slab/panel
anthropomorphic figure with arms and hands rendered in relief
bag- or bucket-like object with an arched handle
horizontal band of small repeated marks running across the panel
animal or creature imagery in profile
justification: Both are upright rectangular stone panels carved in relief that combine an anthropomorphic figure, fanned feather-like forms, vegetal fronds, a handled bag/bucket object and a horizontal band of small repeated marks crossing the upper field, which is a reasonably specific cluster of shared motif types. However the manner of execution is utterly different — A is bold, rounded, sparse high-relief with a few large weathered animal forms on an irregular pillar, while B is dense, flat, finely incised linear work filling the whole surface with a single dominant winged figure — and the relative placement of the shared motifs does not correspond.
